assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Repair ONE isolated LoL AutoCine kill-frame, No.002, exact variant odyssey_variant_1. Image 1 is the authoritative complete crop for this variant. Image 2 is the whole original sheet, for context only. Image 3 is the existing generated candidate to correct. Reconstruct this exact reference design faithfully; preserve its portrait-border geometry, line thickness, palette, central ornament, spacing and supported native decoration. Repair these observed differences: 白背景で肖像穴の縁に暗い小片が見える。穴内断片の要修正。 外周にalphaが0ではない画素が残っている。フレームや発光は保持し、外周と装飾のない余白を完全なalpha 0にする。薄い背景膜を残さない。 Keep the structural central X/cross whenever the original contains it. Do not borrow adjacent strong/weak ornament, invent connectors, change left/right colors, or carry portrait hair accessories into the empty holes. Remove champion people, faces, hair and all writing. Native animal/mascot ornament is allowed only where it belongs to the frame in the exact source. Keep native solid black ornament such as an eclipse disc, dark orb, cat silhouette or castle opening where the reference depicts it; black ornament is not a transparency hole. Preserve blank paper talisman shapes while removing their writing. A rectangular portrait opening must stay rectangular, with the source corner shape; do not insert a circular hole, colored corner wedges or decorative plates. Both portrait holes and negative spaces must be empty alpha-zero. Every outer-border pixel must be alpha-zero: no nearly-transparent canvas tint, residue, paper, backdrop or checkerboard. Keep every supported decorative tip fully inside a generous transparent margin. Crisp native 2K-or-higher RGBA PNG, wide 3:1 composition, no upscaling. Output one usable transparent frame asset only, without a comparison sheet or caption. Canvas requirement: native wide 4:1 landscape at least 2048 pixels on the long edge, ideally 3072x768; use transparent padding without stretching or cropping the reference art.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Repair ONE isolated LoL AutoCine kill-frame, No.002, exact variant empyrean_variant_2. Image 1 is the authoritative complete crop for this variant. Image 2 is the whole original sheet, for context only. Image 3 is the existing generated candidate to correct. Reconstruct this exact reference design faithfully; preserve its portrait-border geometry, line thickness, palette, central ornament, spacing and supported native decoration. Repair these observed differences: 原本では黒い中央コアが、生成版では透過になっている。 外周にalphaが0ではない画素が残っている。フレームや発光は保持し、外周と装飾のない余白を完全なalpha 0にする。薄い背景膜を残さない。 Keep the structural central X/cross whenever the original contains it. Do not borrow adjacent strong/weak ornament, invent connectors, change left/right colors, or carry portrait hair accessories into the empty holes. Remove champion people, faces, hair and all writing. Native animal/mascot ornament is allowed only where it belongs to the frame in the exact source. Keep native solid black ornament such as an eclipse disc, dark orb, cat silhouette or castle opening where the reference depicts it; black ornament is not a transparency hole. Preserve blank paper talisman shapes while removing their writing. A rectangular portrait opening must stay rectangular, with the source corner shape; do not insert a circular hole, colored corner wedges or decorative plates. Both portrait holes and negative spaces must be empty alpha-zero. Every outer-border pixel must be alpha-zero: no nearly-transparent canvas tint, residue, paper, backdrop or checkerboard. Keep every supported decorative tip fully inside a generous transparent margin. Crisp native 2K-or-higher RGBA PNG, wide 3:1 composition, no upscaling. Output one usable transparent frame asset only, without a comparison sheet or caption. Canvas requirement: native wide 4:1 landscape at least 2048 pixels on the long edge, ideally 3072x768; use transparent padding without stretching or cropping the reference art.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Repair ONE isolated LoL AutoCine kill-frame, No.003, exact variant ionia_variant_1. Image 1 is the authoritative complete crop for this variant. Reconstruct this exact reference design faithfully; preserve its portrait-border geometry, line thickness, palette, central ornament, spacing and supported native decoration. Repair these observed differences: 原本より花・蔓・渦の線数が増え、中央渦と肖像枠の間隔が変わっている。厳密一致は要修正。 外周にalphaが0ではない画素が残っている。フレームや発光は保持し、外周と装飾のない余白を完全なalpha 0にする。薄い背景膜を残さない。 Keep the structural central X/cross whenever the original contains it. Do not borrow adjacent strong/weak ornament, invent connectors, change left/right colors, or carry portrait hair accessories into the empty holes. Remove champion people, faces, hair and all writing. Native animal/mascot ornament is allowed only where it belongs to the frame in the exact source. Keep native solid black ornament such as an eclipse disc, dark orb, cat silhouette or castle opening where the reference depicts it; black ornament is not a transparency hole. Preserve blank paper talisman shapes while removing their writing. A rectangular portrait opening must stay rectangular, with the source corner shape; do not insert a circular hole, colored corner wedges or decorative plates. Both portrait holes and negative spaces must be empty alpha-zero. Every outer-border pixel must be alpha-zero: no nearly-transparent canvas tint, residue, paper, backdrop or checkerboard. Keep every supported decorative tip fully inside a generous transparent margin. Crisp native 2K-or-higher RGBA PNG, wide 3:1 composition, no upscaling. Output one usable transparent frame asset only, without a comparison sheet or caption. Canvas requirement: native wide 4:1 landscape at least 2048 pixels on the long edge, ideally 3072x768; use transparent padding without stretching or cropping the reference art.

Output one usable transparent frame asset only, without a comparison sheet or caption. Canvas requirement: native wide 4:1 landscape at least 2048 pixels on the long edge, ideally 3072x768; use transparent padding without stretching or cropping the reference art.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Repair ONE isolated LoL AutoCine kill-frame, No.004, exact variant dark_star_frame. Image 1 is the authoritative complete crop for this variant. Image 2 is the whole original sheet, for context only. Image 3 is the existing generated candidate to correct. Reconstruct this exact reference design faithfully; preserve its portrait-border geometry, line thickness, palette, central ornament, spacing and supported native decoration. Repair these observed differences: 肖像穴は視認で2つ確認。機械検出不足は要確認。原本より左右に大きな棘が追加されている。 外周にalphaが0ではない画素が残っている。フレームや発光は保持し、外周と装飾のない余白を完全なalpha 0にする。薄い背景膜を残さない。 Keep the structural central X/cross whenever the original contains it. Do not borrow adjacent strong/weak ornament, invent connectors, change left/right colors, or carry portrait hair accessories into the empty holes. Remove champion people, faces, hair and all writing. Native animal/mascot ornament is allowed only where it belongs to the frame in the exact source. Keep native solid black ornament such as an eclipse disc, dark orb, cat silhouette or castle opening where the reference depicts it; black ornament is not a transparency hole. Preserve blank paper talisman shapes while removing their writing. A rectangular portrait opening must stay rectangular, with the source corner shape; do not insert a circular hole, colored corner wedges or decorative plates. Both portrait holes and negative spaces must be empty alpha-zero. Every outer-border pixel must be alpha-zero: no nearly-transparent canvas tint, residue, paper, backdrop or checkerboard. Keep every supported decorative tip fully inside a generous transparent margin. Crisp native 2K-or-higher RGBA PNG, wide 3:1 composition, no upscaling. Output one usable transparent frame asset only, without a comparison sheet or caption. Canvas requirement: native wide 4:1 landscape at least 2048 pixels on the long edge, ideally 3072x768; use transparent padding without stretching or cropping the reference art.

Both portrait holes and negative spaces must be empty alpha-zero. Every outer-border pixel must be alpha-zero: no nearly-transparent canvas tint, residue, paper, backdrop or checkerboard. Keep every supported decorative tip fully inside a generous transparent margin. Crisp native 2K-or-higher RGBA PNG, wide 3:1 composition, no upscaling. Output one usable transparent frame asset only, without a comparison sheet or caption. Canvas requirement: native wide 4:1 landscape at least 2048 pixels on the long edge, ideally 3072x768; use transparent padding without stretching or cropping the reference art.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Repair ONE isolated LoL AutoCine kill-frame, No.028, exact variant weak_01. Image 1 is the authoritative complete crop for this variant. Image 2 is the whole original sheet, for context only. Image 3 is the existing generated candidate to correct. Reconstruct this exact reference design faithfully; preserve its portrait-border geometry, line thickness, palette, central ornament, spacing and supported native decoration. Repair these observed differences: 原本にない肖像枠外側のリボンと中央へ伸びる金色の接続棒が追加されている。 外周にalphaが0ではない画素が残っている。フレームや発光は保持し、外周と装飾のない余白を完全なalpha 0にする。薄い背景膜を残さない。 Keep the structural central X/cross whenever the original contains it. Do not borrow adjacent strong/weak ornament, invent connectors, change left/right colors, or carry portrait hair accessories into the empty holes. Remove champion people, faces, hair and all writing. Native animal/mascot ornament is allowed only where it belongs to the frame in the exact source. Keep native solid black ornament such as an eclipse disc, dark orb, cat silhouette or castle opening where the reference depicts it; black ornament is not a transparency hole. Preserve blank paper talisman shapes while removing their writing. A rectangular portrait opening must stay rectangular, with the source corner shape; do not insert a circular hole, colored corner wedges or decorative plates. Both portrait holes and negative spaces must be empty alpha-zero. Every outer-border pixel must be alpha-zero: no nearly-transparent canvas tint, residue, paper, backdrop or checkerboard. Keep every supported decorative tip fully inside a generous transparent margin. Crisp native 2K-or-higher RGBA PNG, wide 3:1 composition, no upscaling. Output one usable transparent frame asset only, without a comparison sheet or caption. Canvas requirement: native wide 4:1 landscape at least 2048 pixels on the long edge, ideally 3072x768; use transparent padding without stretching or cropping the reference art.

Preserve the reference silhouette, palette, material, exact portrait-ring shape (round or angular), both left/right borders, central ornament, connecting bars, spacing, line weights and theme motifs. Weak and strong variants must remain distinct. Remove champion faces, heads, hair, people, portrait occupants, ALL text/numbers/labels and scenery. Both portrait interiors must be entirely empty alpha-zero holes. Keep native decorative animal/mascot ornaments only if part of the frame. Do not add generic symbols, larger invented central emblems, extra frames or a whole contact sheet. No logo, watermark, paper or checkerboard painted into pixels. If portrait frames and the central ornament are separate in the exact crop, preserve those gaps; do not invent connecting bars, outer arcs, stars, gems, flowers or spikes. Never borrow ornament from adjacent strong variants. A central X or cross that belongs to the frame is a required structural ornament: retain its exact form; remove explanatory writing only, not the cross.

Output one usable transparent frame asset only, without a comparison sheet or caption. Canvas requirement: native wide 4:1 landscape at least 2048 pixels on the long edge, ideally 3072x768; use transparent padding without stretching or cropping the reference art.

Both portrait holes and negative spaces must be empty alpha-zero. Every outer-border pixel must be alpha-zero: no nearly-transparent canvas tint, residue, paper, backdrop or checkerboard. Output one usable transparent frame asset only, without a comparison sheet or caption. Canvas requirement: native wide 4:1 landscape at least 2048 pixels on the long edge, ideally 3072x768; use transparent padding without stretching or cropping the reference art.

Both portrait holes and negative spaces must be empty alpha-zero. Every outer-border pixel must be alpha-zero: no nearly-transparent canvas tint, residue, paper, backdrop or checkerboard. Output one usable transparent frame asset only, without a comparison sheet or caption. Make ONE high-resolution isolated horizontal kill-frame asset, source No.087, exact variant steel_valkyries_strong, theme steel_valkyries, intensity strong, role unspecified. Image 1 is the exact cropped variant to reconstruct. Image 2 is the complete original sheet for context: reconstruct ONLY the variant shown in Image 1, never another row. Create a crisp richly detailed 2K-or-higher painted metallic/fantasy/sci-fi UI asset on an actual transparent RGBA canvas, preferably 2560 pixels wide, no blurry upscaling. Preserve the reference silhouette, palette, material, exact portrait-ring shape (round or angular), both left/right borders, central ornament, connecting bars, spacing, line weights and theme motifs. Weak and strong variants must remain distinct. Remove champion faces, heads, hair, people, portrait occupants, ALL text/numbers/labels and scenery. Both portrait interiors must be entirely empty alpha-zero holes. Keep native decorative animal/mascot ornaments only if part of the frame. Do not add generic symbols, larger invented central emblems, extra frames or a whole contact sheet. No logo, watermark, paper or checkerboard painted into pixels. Keep the ENTIRE frame and every feather/flame/light/particle tip inside a generous fully transparent 15% margin on every side. Local translucent glow is allowed; the background and all negative spaces must be truly transparent. Single usable frame only, no title or presentation.  Additional source-fidelity constraints: empty reference spaces must remain empty. If portrait frames and the central ornament are separate in the exact crop, preserve those gaps; do not invent connecting bars, outer arcs, stars, gems, flowers or spikes. Never borrow ornament from adjacent strong variants. A central X or cross that belongs to the frame is a required structural ornament: retain its exact form; remove explanatory writing only, not the cross.  Keep native solid black eclipse discs, dark orbs and other dark ornament opaque where the exact source shows them; these are not empty portrait holes. Preserve blank paper talisman silhouettes while removing all writing. Do not replace missing writing with new objects or characters.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Repair ONE isolated LoL AutoCine kill-frame, No.087, exact variant broken_covenant_weak. Image 1 is the authoritative complete crop for this variant. Image 2 is the whole original sheet, for context only. Image 3 is the existing generated candidate to correct. Reconstruct this exact reference design faithfully; preserve its portrait-border geometry, line thickness, palette, central ornament, spacing and supported native decoration. Repair these observed differences: 原本の弱案の細い銀赤のリングに対し、大きな赤い葉・棘が肖像穴内側へ追加されている。 外周にalphaが0ではない画素が残っている。フレームや発光は保持し、外周と装飾のない余白を完全なalpha 0にする。薄い背景膜を残さない。 Keep the structural central X/cross whenever the original contains it. Do not borrow adjacent strong/weak ornament, invent connectors, change left/right colors, or carry portrait hair accessories into the empty holes. Remove champion people, faces, hair and all writing. Native animal/mascot ornament is allowed only where it belongs to the frame in the exact source. Keep native solid black ornament such as an eclipse disc, dark orb, cat silhouette or castle opening where the reference depicts it; black ornament is not a transparency hole. Preserve blank paper talisman shapes while removing their writing. A rectangular portrait opening must stay rectangular, with the source corner shape; do not insert a circular hole, colored corner wedges or decorative plates. Both portrait holes and negative spaces must be empty alpha-zero. Every outer-border pixel must be alpha-zero: no nearly-transparent canvas tint, residue, paper, backdrop or checkerboard. Keep every supported decorative tip fully inside a generous transparent margin. Crisp native 2K-or-higher RGBA PNG, wide 3:1 composition, no upscaling. Output one usable transparent frame asset only, without a comparison sheet or caption. Canvas requirement: native wide 4:1 landscape at least 2048 pixels on the long edge, ideally 3072x768; use transparent padding without stretching or cropping the reference art.

Image 2 is the whole original sheet, for context only. Image 3 is the existing generated candidate to correct. Reconstruct this exact reference design faithfully; preserve its portrait-border geometry, line thickness, palette, central ornament, spacing and supported native decoration. Repair these observed differences: 原本の弱案リングは簡素なのに、左右外周へ大きな白赤の炎状装飾が追加されている。 外周にalphaが0ではない画素が残っている。フレームや発光は保持し、外周と装飾のない余白を完全なalpha 0にする。薄い背景膜を残さない。 Keep the structural central X/cross whenever the original contains it. Do not borrow adjacent strong/weak ornament, invent connectors, change left/right colors, or carry portrait hair accessories into the empty holes. Remove champion people, faces, hair and all writing. Native animal/mascot ornament is allowed only where it belongs to the frame in the exact source. Keep native solid black ornament such as an eclipse disc, dark orb, cat silhouette or castle opening where the reference depicts it; black ornament is not a transparency hole. Preserve blank paper talisman shapes while removing their writing. A rectangular portrait opening must stay rectangular, with the source corner shape; do not insert a circular hole, colored corner wedges or decorative plates. Both portrait holes and negative spaces must be empty alpha-zero. Every outer-border pixel must be alpha-zero: no nearly-transparent canvas tint, residue, paper, backdrop or checkerboard. Keep every supported decorative tip fully inside a generous transparent margin. Crisp native 2K-or-higher RGBA PNG, wide 3:1 composition, no upscaling. Output one usable transparent frame asset only, without a comparison sheet or caption. Canvas requirement: native wide 4:1 landscape at least 2048 pixels on the long edge, ideally 3072x768; use transparent padding without stretching or cropping the reference art.
